title: Encoding information into an embroidery of topological defects in liquid crystals - Nature Materials
html:
A photopatterned alignment layer with a periodic lattice of vortices acts as a substrate for pinned defect lines in a liquid crystal. These topological defect lines can be rearranged by optical manipulation into a vast number of states that can store information.
